title: The special marts: res/field/shops/special_marts.json
description: The shops 239 to 242 and 247 to 250, whose lists grow with a level that KeyDataSave_GetProgress keeps (its value 1 for the first four, 0 for the others), one of six by sSpecialMartLevels, the files that SPECIAL_POKE_MART_HEADERS names + 6 of archive a/2/8/2 (ShopUI_LoadSpecialPokeMartItems in src/ov036/scrcmd_shop.c). No script opens them and all their lists are empty in White 2; tools/data/shop_data.py packs them so that the archive is whole. A string value is the name of a constant from generated/ or include/constants/.

shop.description: The shop's ID, in the order of SPECIAL_POKE_MART_HEADERS

levels.description: The items of each level, in menu order
